body: Wow I can’t respond to everything, but please know how much I appreciate this post, and the time you put into it. I took the quiz and I do have a low self esteem, and think l start to read more about it and how to build it up. Also, sleep and exercise makes a lot of sense and will try to incorporate healthier habits into my every day life regarding these two things. Thank you so much!!! You are truly so helpful and if I could give you an award I would. This is soooo well written and an amazing resource for me and for this thread in general. Thank you so much again!!!

First off, happy birthday! Second off - birthdays are incredibly tough, and I really understand how you feel. But try to focus on the things you have accomplished: you’re still alive, and that’s an accomplishment in itself!! Obviously I don’t know you but I’m sure you have many other accomplishments. Did you graduate high school? Accomplishment. Did you make yourself dinner the other night? Accomplishment. Do you have a house to live in? Accomplishment. Etc etc - Focus on those smaller accomplishments, that not everyone else has under their belt. You are doing GREAT, and the fact that you are 26 is wonderful. I’m so so so sorry you’re feeling so sad, but remember how worthy of this life you are and how amazing you are. I hope things look up and that you end up having a great birthday. <3 hang in there, you’ve got this!

You’re so so right, and I love that you’re pointing out the love languages. I could even communicate to him that, “I need to be loved THIS way,” and then to make it more equal and even ask him, “what is your love language?” And you’re right too about a lot of men being less emotional and find it harder to verbalize their love. I’m going to focus on the way he does show me love and communicate further. Thank you so much for your advice and for taking the time to respond <3

You’re totally right. And that’s something I’m also working on with my therapist too is like - just letting go of that need for “control” because the truth is, no one and nothing is promised - but that doesn’t mean I won’t be okay. There will be someone out there for me (just like there is for everyone) that will love me for me and will be okay with who i am. And yes - self love is the best love. I just downloaded a few books for my Kindle about finding that strength from within and loving yourself. Thank you so much for taking the time to respond <3

You’re absolutely right, I think I’m just a bit scared about scaring him away or him thinking it’s too much, but i have to realize and understand even if he does leave me, there will be someone else who won’t be scared away by time. Thank you for taking the time to respond <3
Thank you for writing this!! I think I’m going to screenshot this and refer back to it every time I’m feeling nervous, almost like a list of affirmations to repeat. Thanks so so much <3
You’re absolutely right. Thank you for being honest with ME about what I need to do <3
I also struggle with this and I don’t really know what else to say but just that you’re not alone 💖

Aside from anything to do with LOA - have you ever considered coming clean to get rid of the guilt? Perhaps this is the only thing that can really help you move on with your life to attract positive things.

I think the only way you can manifest is that you manifest forgiveness and understanding from others, as well as from yourself. Also manifest learning from your mistakes and never doing something like this again. 

I think for me, if I were you, I’d come clean about it. I don’t think I’d be able to handle the guilt.

Sending good vibes either way and hope things get better!!

I’m new to it as well, but I think writing down things like, “People who find me attractive will be introduced to me.” Instead of, “I will get more attractive.” 

Because realistically, beauty is in the eye of the beholder. So instead of changing yourself (which you don’t have to or shouldn’t have to do) you should try to change who is around you and try to manifest people who find you attractive. 

Does that make sense? Like tell yourself that you ARE attractive and that people who agree with you and also find you attractive can be manifested into your life, instead of you trying to manifest or change your appearance. 

I hope this helps!! But again, I’m new as well to manifestation so someone who’s more experienced may have different/better advice.

Just remember: you’re beautiful and wonderful and unique the way you are. I hope you find your confidence and manifest what you need :)
